### Notes

- ALT, AST, BILI and ALP are all present in SDTM LB, so the criterion is fully derivable.
- CRIT1 = 'ALT or AST >= 3xULN AND BILI >= 2xULN' evaluated per subject at the same or nearby visit; CRIT1FL='Y' when met. Use LBSTNRHI as ULN.
- Report as a subject-level count, not a record count — Hy's Law is a subject property.
- N-GATE CAVEAT: this study has 17 randomized subjects (Placebo 5 / Low 5 / High 7). All inferential statistics are illustrative and must not be interpreted.
- CRIT1 = ALT or AST >= 3xULN **and** total bilirubin >= 2xULN, evaluated per subject per analysis visit using the record-level `LBSTNRHI` as ULN.
- Counted at **subject** level: Hy's Law is a property of a subject, not of a record.
- **0 subjects met the criterion.** This is a genuine negative finding, not a missing derivation — the component maxima above show how far the observed values sit from the thresholds.
- All values computed from ADaM via the persisted ARD (`ard.csv`); no value is hand-entered.
- Rounding: SAS convention (half away from zero), applied at display time only.

> **N-GATE WARNING.** This study randomized 17 subjects (Placebo 5 / Zanomaline Low 5 / Zanomaline High 7). Every inferential statistic in this display is **illustrative only** and must not be interpreted as evidence of effect or of absence of effect.
